summary: Learn to formulate, train and evaluate a basic reinforcement learning policy. Review the five-day course outline and practical exercises.
lede: Reinforcement learning training covers how to formulate sequential decision problems and train and evaluate a basic policy. It is for foundation-level machine-learning engineers, research assistants and data scientists working with agent environments and repeatable experiments. You practise inspecting Gymnasium environments, specifying states, actions and rewards, configuring Python training runs, monitoring logs and checkpoints, and evaluating a policy separately against a baseline.
audienceIntro: If your work involves sequential decisions, agent environments or repeatable learning experiments, this foundation course connects those tasks to practical policy training and evaluation.
modules: Policy Training with PyTorch or TensorFlow
prerequisites: Basic Python programming is required for the training-script exercises. Bring a laptop with a Python environment and either PyTorch or TensorFlow available; no prior reinforcement learning experience is assumed.
